title: Computational phenotypes: traits, states, or moving targets?
description: At our September 25 meeting, we discussed individual differences, repeated measurement, parameter stability, and what makes a useful computational phenotype, drawing on Schurr et al. (2024) and the companion paper by Katahira, Oba & Toyama (2024).

readings.label: Schurr et al. (2024)
readings.title: Dynamic computational phenotyping of human cognition
readings.authors: Schurr, Reznik, Hillman, Bhui, et al.

readings.label: Katahira, Oba & Toyama (2024)
readings.title: Does the reliability of computational models truly improve with hierarchical modeling? Some recommendations and considerations for the assessment of model parameter reliability

title: What should EDM Megalab be?
description: Everyone in the Emory community with an interest in decision-making is welcome. Building on the broad participation at our September 25 meeting, we will get to know one another, map shared interests, methods, datasets, and opportunities, and shape priorities for the series. Join the conversation whether you attended last time or are new to EDM Megalab.

title: WIP presentations
description: Works-in-progress presentations from Pete Hitchcock and Michael Hallquist, with time for discussion and feedback. Background papers for Michael’s presentation are linked with this meeting. No advance reading is required.
